Response:
# Bangalore Software Engineer Job-Search Sprint

A focused 3-week plan for a backend engineer moving into data engineering in Bangalore, built around **15 applications**, weekday **2-hour blocks**, **4 hours on Saturdays**, and **Sundays off**. It balances resume tailoring, interview prep, networking, and steady submissions.

## 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-21: Weekly Roadmap

| Week | Dates | Focus | Key Tasks | Deliverable |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Week 1 | Apr 1–5 | Positioning | Update resume for data engineering; refresh LinkedIn; shortlist target companies; start skills gap list | Ready-to-send resume v1 + target list |
| Week 2 | Apr 6–12 | Applications + Prep | Submit first 5 applications; practice SQL/Python/data modeling; do 2 networking outreach rounds | 5 applications sent + prep rhythm established |
| Week 3 | Apr 13–19 | Scale + Interview Readiness | Submit 7 more applications; mock interviews; refine project stories; follow up on outreach | 12 total applications + interview-ready stories |
| Wrap-up | Apr 20–21 | Final Push | Submit final 3 applications; review pipeline; organize follow-ups and next-step tracker | **15 applications total** + clean tracker |

## Day-by-Day Job Search Plan

### 2026-04-01, Wednesday
- Resume: Reframe backend experience toward data pipelines, ETL, SQL, Spark, Airflow, and reliability.
- Applications: Build a target-company tracker with 20–25 Bangalore roles.
- Prep: Identify 3 resume bullet points that can be rewritten with data impact.
- Milestone: Resume v1 outline complete.

### 2026-04-02, Thursday
- Resume: Rewrite summary and core skills for data engineering.
- Networking: Update LinkedIn headline and “About” section.
- Prep: Collect 2 project stories that show scale, debugging, and data handling.
- Milestone: LinkedIn profile aligned with new direction.

### 2026-04-03, Friday
- Applications: Apply to 2 roles.
- Prep: SQL practice on joins, window functions, and aggregation.
- Networking: Send 3 outreach messages to Bangalore data engineers/recruiters.
- Milestone: First applications submitted.

### 2026-04-04, Saturday
- Resume: Create 2 variants if needed: general data engineer and analytics/data platform.
- Applications: Apply to 2 more roles.
- Prep: Python practice for data manipulation and scripting.
- Networking: Follow up on outreach sent earlier in the week.
- Milestone: 4 total applications.

### 2026-04-05, Sunday
- Off day.
- Optional light activity: Review saved roles and note interview themes for next week.

### 2026-04-06, Monday
- Applications: Apply to 1 role.
- Prep: Data modeling basics: star schema, normalization, fact/dimension tables.
- Networking: Send 2 new outreach messages.
- Milestone: 5 total applications.

### 2026-04-07, Tuesday
- Applications: Apply to 1 role.
- Prep: Practice explaining backend-to-data-engineering transition in 60 seconds.
- Resume: Tune bullets to emphasize ownership, pipelines, and data quality.
- Milestone: Clear transition pitch drafted.

### 2026-04-08, Wednesday
- Applications: Apply to 1 role.
- Prep: SQL timed practice set.
- Networking: Reach out to 2 alumni or ex-colleagues in Bangalore.
- Milestone: 7 total applications.

### 2026-04-09, Thursday
- Applications: Apply to 1 role.
- Prep: Review Spark, Airflow, Kafka, and batch vs streaming concepts.
- Resume: Tailor one version for product companies and one for startups.
- Milestone: Core DE stack refreshed.

### 2026-04-10, Friday
- Applications: Apply to 1 role.
- Prep: Mock interview on SQL + project walkthrough.
- Networking: Follow up on earlier outreach and ask for referrals where appropriate.
- Milestone: 9 total applications.

### 2026-04-11, Saturday
- Applications: Apply to 1 role.
- Prep: Python coding practice focused on data transformations.
- Resume: Add measurable outcomes to 2–3 bullets.
- Networking: Send 3 new messages to hiring managers/recruiters.
- Milestone: 10 total applications.

### 2026-04-12, Sunday
- Off day.
- Optional light activity: Review interview notes and adjust weak areas.

### 2026-04-13, Monday
- Applications: Apply to 1 role.
- Prep: System design for data pipelines, ingestion, storage, and reliability.
- Networking: Send 2 outreach messages.
- Milestone: 11 total applications.

### 2026-04-14, Tuesday
- Applications: Apply to 1 role.
- Prep: Practice behavioral answers using STAR format.
- Resume: Final check for keyword match against target job descriptions.
- Milestone: Resume and stories sharpened.

### 2026-04-15, Wednesday
- Applications: Apply to 1 role.
- Prep: SQL + data modeling revision.
- Networking: Ask 1–2 warm contacts for referral support.
- Milestone: 12 total applications.

### 2026-04-16, Thursday
- Applications: Apply to 1 role.
- Prep: Mock interview focused on backend-to-DE transition.
- Resume: Create a quick customization checklist for each application.
- Milestone: Interview narrative ready.

### 2026-04-17, Friday
- Applications: Apply to 1 role.
- Prep: Review common DE screening questions and concise answers.
- Networking: Follow up on referral asks and recruiter messages.
- Milestone: 13 total applications.

### 2026-04-18, Saturday
- Applications: Apply to 1 role.
- Prep: Full-length mock interview: SQL, Python, pipeline design, behavioral.
- Resume: Final polish based on any interview feedback.
- Networking: Send 2–3 additional high-quality outreach messages.
- Milestone: 14 total applications.

### 2026-04-19, Sunday
- Off day.
- Optional light activity: Rest and reset for final push.

### 2026-04-20, Monday
- Applications: Apply to 1 role.
- Prep: Review all active applications and interview statuses.
- Networking: Follow up on earlier messages and referrals.
- Milestone: 15 total applications reached.

### 2026-04-21, Tuesday
- Review: Audit the application tracker, callbacks, and response rates.
- Prep: Identify top 3 weak areas for the next cycle.
- Networking: Send thank-you notes to anyone who helped.
- Milestone: Next-step plan ready.

## Weekly Time Allocation

- **Weekdays, 2 hours**
  - 45 min: applications or tailoring
  - 30 min: interview prep
  - 20 min: networking
  - 25 min: resume/trackers/follow-ups
- **Saturdays, 4 hours**
  - 90 min: batch applications
  - 60 min: deep prep
  - 45 min: networking/referrals
  - 45 min: resume iteration and review
- **Sundays**
  - Off

## Application Pace

- Week 1: 4 applications
- Week 2: 6 applications
- Week 3: 5 applications
- Total: **15 applications**

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Track Jobs] https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/
Action: [Button: Search Bangalore] https://www.naukri.com/
Action: [Button: Practice SQL] https://leetcode.com/problemset/database/
Action: [Button: Prep Data Eng] https://roadmap.sh/data-engineer

## Sources

- LinkedIn Jobs: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/
- Naukri India: https://www.naukri.com/
- Data Engineer roadmap: https://roadmap.sh/data-engineer
